test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question: When were the tremors felt in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
solution:
The correct answer is** 'before the sunrise'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions the seismic tremor occurred in the "pre-dawn tranquillity" of the Andaman Sea. 
 
• Specifically, the event happened at "5:50 a.m. on Friday."
 
• "Pre-dawn" refers to the time before sunrise, and 5:50 a.m. fits this description.
 
• The passage's description of the event occurring in the early morning aligns with the time before sunrise.
 
• The context does not suggest any other times (afternoon, night, or after sunset) for the earthquake.
 
• The phrase "momentarily agitating the ocean's placid surface" further suggests a calm, early morning scene.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "In the afternoon" does not correspond to the described time of 5:50 a.m.
 
• "At night" does not align with the "pre-dawn" timing mentioned.
 
• "After the sunset" contradicts the early morning timing described in the passage.
